database: PubMed (MEDLINE and PubMed Central), searched through the PubMed search interface
note: Counts are as returned on the date run; re-running a query later will return more records as PubMed grows.

searches.query: ("quality-adjusted life years"[MeSH Terms] OR "disability-adjusted life years"[Title/Abstract] OR "health expectancy"[Title/Abstract] OR "healthy life expectancy"[Title/Abstract]) AND (measurement[Title/Abstract] OR valuation[Title/Abstract] OR conceptual[Title/Abstract])

searches.tradition: Quality of life in older adults
searches.query: "quality of life"[MeSH Terms] AND aged[MeSH Terms] AND ("health-related quality of life"[Title/Abstract] OR "EQ-5D"[Title/Abstract]) AND (validity[Title/Abstract] OR measurement[Title/Abstract])
("frailty index"[Title/Abstract] OR "deficit accumulation"[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR prognosis[Title/Abstract] OR prognostic[Title/Abstract] OR vulnerability[Title/Abstract])
searches.revision: The first version, without 'vulnerability', returned 2418 records and missed Rockwood and Mitnitski (2007), a conceptual review that never mentions mortality.

searches.query: "intrinsic capacity"[Title/Abstract] AND (older[Title/Abstract] OR ageing[Title/Abstract] OR aging[Title/Abstract])
ATHLOS[Title/Abstract] OR ("health metric"[Title/Abstract] AND ("item response theory"[Title/Abstract] OR "factor analysis"[Title/Abstract]))

("capability approach"[Title/Abstract] OR "ICECAP-O"[Title/Abstract] OR "capability wellbeing"[Title/Abstract] OR (capability[Title/Abstract] AND Sen[Title/Abstract])) AND (health[Title/Abstract] OR "quality of life"[Title/Abstract])
searches.revision: The first version, without the capability-and-Sen term, returned 314 records and missed Grewal et al. (2006), the qualitative groundwork for ICECAP-O.

searches.query: "social determinants of health"[MeSH Terms] AND aged[MeSH Terms] AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR "functional ability"[Title/Abstract] OR disability[Title/Abstract])
"social vulnerability"[Title/Abstract] AND (index[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract]) AND (aged[MeSH Terms] OR older[Title/Abstract])
intersectionality[Title/Abstract] AND health[Title/Abstract] AND (measurement[Title/Abstract] OR quantitative[Title/Abstract])
formative[Title/Abstract] AND reflective[Title/Abstract] AND (measurement[Title/Abstract] OR indicators[Title/Abstract])
hemophilia[MeSH Terms] AND aged[MeSH Terms] AND ("quality of life"[Title/Abstract] OR comorbidity[Title/Abstract] OR comorbidities[Title/Abstract])
searches.note: PubMed maps hemophilia[MeSH Terms] to 'hemophilia a'.

coverage_check.method: Each final query was combined with the PubMed identifier of key works the review cites (query AND <pmid>[uid]); a result of one record means the search retrieves the work.

coverage_check.result: 8 of 8 PubMed-indexed key works retrieved by the final queries.
coverage_check.outside_pubmed: Works outside PubMed's scope, such as Bowleg (2008) in Sex Roles, Jarvis et al. (2003) in the Journal of Consumer Research, Sen's philosophy and the WHO and NHATS documentation, are not covered by these searches.
